hypothesis: Jev can distinguish reversal recovery from persistent adverse momentum using only closed-bar context. Test one fixed rubric without optimizing prompts on outcomes.
baseline: Current restored wick-break Pine, RR1, next contiguous M5 open
higher_timeframe_rules: None; causal M5-derived trend/volatility context only
entry_rules: Current Pine candidates; Jev accept with P(accept)>=0.5; invalid/failed/latency>=300 seconds skipped. Entry i+2 for AI and latency-matched control, all intervening bars contiguous. No candidate outcome supplied to API.

exit_rules.stop: RR1 exact Pine formula 2*entry-target; RR1.3/1.5 target reward / requested RR rounded outward to tick; Python float reference, not TV runtime verified

periods.boundary: Each year starts flat, warmup features retained, signals from within year only; report year-end open MTM separately. Full 3-year continuous book is a separate descriptive run.

final_period_prior_exposure: All years already explored; descriptive comparison only, not pristine holdout
candidate_budget: 7 fixed arms: original RR1; delay2 noAI RR1/1.3/1.5; delay2 Jev RR1/1.3/1.5. One rubric, no revisions after results.
search_space: Select at most one Jev RR by highest 2023 average net R, then report 2024/2025 without reselection. Report other arms as descriptive only.
cost_and_fill_model: 1 pip round trip hypothetical, plus 1.2 pip stress; not current GMO quote. Chart OHLC, gap exits at open, same-bar SL first. No additional swap/slippage beyond combined assumed cost.
position_sizing_and_currency: One position per pair, no lot/account assumptions. Report pips and R, not monetary portfolio profit. Cross-pair pips PF descriptive only.
acceptance_gates: Selected AI in each 2024 and 2025: >=100 closes and >=70% original baseline count; win rate >=both original and same-RR delay control+2 percentage points; R-normalized PF>=1.2 and >=both original and same-RR delay control; average net R and net plus open R above both controls; combined bar-close MTM DD_R <=1.2 times original; positive net plus open R at 1.2 pip cost. All API cases valid and completed; otherwise no adoption. Even passing only permits fresh-data forward testing.
cross_symbol_rule: At least 4 of 7 pairs positive net plus open R in each evaluation year
code_identifier: sha256 snapshot before paid run in agent_runs/bb3_jev_20260925/run_manifest.json
frozen_at: 2026-09-25 before profitability examination or paid API calls
